nome_articolo: Sideshow DC Comics Aquaman Premium Format Aquaman: Lord of the Deep (Statua)
descrizione:
Sideshow presents the Aquaman™: Lord of the Deep Premium Format™ Figure, an ominous DC collectible.

Sideshow's Mythos collection captures the limitless, untold potential of fan-favorite characters across many multiverses. As a collection, Mythos adds unique artistic storytelling to the most popular fictional people and places, taking key themes and expanding them into anything our imagination can conceive of.

This Aquaman collectible utilizes eldritch horror elements to tell a tale of an aging Arthur Curry whose body has melded with his watery home. Measuring 29" tall, 16" wide, and 15.3" deep, the Aquaman: Lord of the Deep Premium Format™ Figure rises from the trenches into a base of tumultuous, translucent waves. Barnacles and flesh, kelp and costume, all appear indiscernible at every angle as he becomes one with the creatures and environment he has sworn to protect. Whether his sacred duty has transformed him into a beast or a savior is a question best left to the sea and sand.

Inspired by the character's comic book appearance, the fully sculpted DC statue presents an eerie guardian covered in crustaceans, fish scales, and other cold-blooded components. Distressed metallic paint on his rusted armor echoes a shipwreck long forgotten in the cold, unforgiving ravines of the ocean floor. Aquaman wields a weathered gold trident while he marches forward, braced for battle and bearing all the scars of his past. A red squid joins him from fathoms deep, and as the hero's own green tentacles join it, man becomes myth ... becomes monster.

Let the tide carry the Aquaman: Lord of the Deep Premium Format™ Figure to your collection today!

Size: 73.7 x 40.6 x 38.9 cm (29" H x 16" W x 15.3" L)

nome_articolo: Ember Toys Mazinger BLAZE Series Diecast Mazinkaiser Original Version (Action Figure)
descrizione:
The Ember Toys diecast action figure series BLAZE is finally here! Kicking off this new series is the BLAZE Mazinkaiser (Original Edition).

Features an innovative, world-first double-action functionality

- Electric spinning Turbo Smasher Punch motors are built into both forearms! The Kaiser Pilder (with magnets) can be moved close to activate the switch, allowing the forearms to rotate at high speed. The built-in battery allows the figure to be displayed wirelessly with effect parts, even when separated. (Requires LR41 batteries x6, sold separately)
- Light-emitting Fire Blaster LED screen on the chest displays "Z," "Demon," and "God" sequentially Realistically recreates the charging and firing of photon energy with a blinking light effect. *Kaiser Pilder with built-in magnets can be moved close to activate the magnetic switch. (Requires LR44 batteries x3, sold separately)

Superior Sculpting Quality

- Rebuilt with a modern, streamlined design based on the powerful look of the game version.
- The seamless Kaiser Scrander and sleek head design project a truly unique presence.

Impressive specs and range of motion. Massive size.

- Head height: approx. 26cm (approx. 39cm total height with Kaiser Scrander attached).
- 65 points of articulation across the body, with a unique construction that allows for dynamic posing.
- Durable design: The thighs and shins of the figure are made with diecast parts. The internal frame also uses die-cast and POM material to maximize stability.

Plenty of accessories

- Armaments: Shoulder slicer (can be unsheathed), Giganto Missile
- Display: Parts for recreating the Jet Boomerang and a dedicated stand with rotating turntable included

nome_articolo: RE:EDIT Halo 1/12 Chief Mjolnir Mark V Recolor Ver.
descrizione:
Master Chief's MJOLNIR MARK V armor from 1000toys' RE:EDIT line is back with a new look!

The fully articulated action figure of Master Chief in the iconic MJOLNIR MARK V armor from HALO: Combat Evolved, is being reintroduced from 1000toys!
While the package includes everything from the initial release in 2020, the coloring has been revised to produce a look closer to the image of Master Chief portrayed in the game.
Made with ABS plastic and diecast parts, the product achieves a balance between sharp detail and feel of weight. The armor's design has been modified by Japanese mechanical designer IZUMOJUKI, adding mechanical details to create a captivating and realistic Master Chief while staying true to the concept of the design from the original game.
Accessories include the MA5B Assault Rifle, the M6D Pistol, a Covenant Energy Sword and a variety of hand parts.
3mm hardpoints are positioned on the side of the thighs and on the back, making it possible to attach the MA5B Assault Rifle and the M6D Pistol to the figure.
When not in use, the hardpoints can be concealed with the cover parts included in the package.

Set Contents:

- Main figure
- MA5B Assault rifle
- 2 x M6D handgun
- M6D mount part (LR)
- Energy sword
- Gripping hand (LR)
- Open hand (LR)
- Flat hand (LR)
- Gun holding hand (LR)
Energy sword holding hand (LR)
